description: Full speaker-text timing check of a variant as Markdown (same format as <name>_Sprechertext_<LANG>.md from the local kit): per slide in talk order the planned seconds (note.seconds), word count, estimate at wpm and the deviation, totals and target_duration_sec, then the full text of every slide with its start time. Slides without planned seconds are marked '—' and use the estimate for start times. Required: presentation_id and variant_id or language. Optional: wpm (default 130), save_document (true → also stored as a .md document on the presentation). Returns { markdown, rows:[{folie, titel, soll_sec, woerter, geschaetzt_sec, abweichung_sec, start_sec}], total_planned_sec, total_estimated_sec, words, target_sec, slides_without_plan, document_id? }.

save_document.description: true = also store the Markdown as a document on the presentation

wpm.description: Speaking rate in words per minute for estimates (default 130)

name: check_speaker_timing
